environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a single HTTPS listener on port 443 forwarding to target group on port 8080. ALB access logs are enabled to S3. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The application runs as a systemd service under a dedicated 'appuser' account. SQLite database file is stored on an EBS volume mounted at /var/app/data with filesystem permissions 0644. Environment variable FLASK_DEBUG=0.
